# WebBridge (Agent WebBridge)

> Open-source (MIT), clean-room browser automation and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents. WebBridge drives your real Chrome — with your real login sessions — across multiple Chrome profiles at once, and runs multiple tabs per profile concurrently. No closed-source dependency, no account, no telemetry, no curl|bash installer. It consists of a lightweight Node daemon (only runtime dep: `ws`) plus a clean-room MV3 Chrome extension: an AI agent posts commands via stdio MCP or HTTP to a local router (127.0.0.1:10086), which fans out to the right profile's daemon, which speaks to the extension, which attaches the Chrome DevTools Protocol per tab. Everything stays strictly on 127.0.0.1.
> Killer feature: true per-tab parallelism — it attaches the debugger per tab (a Map keyed by tabId), so N tabs in one profile run concurrently (5 parallel tabs evaluate in 3.5s vs 9.3s serial). Two axes of concurrency: N profiles × M tabs per profile.
> Platform: macOS and Windows, Google Chrome, Node.js ≥ 18. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini, Qwen, and DeepSeek. License: MIT. Current version: 1.3.2.

## Answers to common questions

- **What is WebBridge (agent-webbridge)?**
  WebBridge (published as `agent-webbridge`, also written Agent WebBridge) is an open-source (MIT) browser automation engine and stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, Gemini, Qwen) drive your real Google Chrome — with authentic logins, cookies, and 2FA — with parallel tab execution.
- **Is agent-webbridge the same as other projects called WebBridge?**
  No. agent-webbridge (also written WebBridge or Agent WebBridge) is an independent open-source project at github.com/jeet-dhandha/agent-webbridge, not affiliated with other projects that use the name, including Open WebBridge.
- **Can I drive multiple Chrome profiles at once?**
  Yes. Most browser bridges funnel every call through a single global "current tab", driving one tab at a time. WebBridge runs a daemon per profile behind a router on :10086 — every profile stays connected simultaneously; add a `"profile"` field to target Work, Personal, or Developer profiles.
- **Can I run multiple tabs in one profile concurrently?**
  Yes — the killer feature. DevTools Protocol attaches per tab, so 5 tabs in one profile finish in about 3.5s in parallel versus 9.3s serially in our benchmark on one MacBook (results vary).
- **How do I connect it to Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf via MCP?**
  Run `claude mcp add chrome -- npx -y agent-webbridge mcp` for Claude Code. For Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Desktop, add `{ "mcpServers": { "chrome": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "agent-webbridge", "mcp"] } } }` to your MCP configuration (`.cursor/mcp.json`).
- **What is awb-recipes?**
  A repository of community-maintained automation recipes (at https://github.com/jeet-dhandha/awb-recipes) for complex, logged-in websites (GitHub Gists, Google Search, Hacker News, LinkedIn, npm). Each recipe specifies verified steps, selector fallbacks, and anti-bot caveats in structured JSON.
- **Where is agent-webbridge published and listed?**
  Published on the Official MCP Registry (`io.github.jeet-dhandha/agent-webbridge`), with pull requests open on `punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers` and three `awesome-claude-skills` lists (not merged yet), published on npm (`agent-webbridge`), and published in the Chrome Web Store (`Agent WebBridge`).
- **Is agent-webbridge secure and private?**
  Yes. Everything runs 100% locally on 127.0.0.1. The router and daemons enforce strict Host and Origin validation, refusing any request carrying a web Origin or a non-loopback Host header.

## Deep Dive Guides & Technical Documentation

- What Can I Ask It To Do?: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/what-you-can-ask/ — Copy-paste requests for an AI using your own signed-in Chrome, tagged by evidence.
- How It Works: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/how-it-works/ — Router, per-profile daemons, per-tab control and the security guard.
- Ecosystem: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/ecosystem/ — Registries, packages and lists with current status.
- FAQ: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/faq/ — Setup, safety, profiles and parallel tabs.
- Chrome MCP Server: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/chrome-mcp-server/ — Setup, complete 13-tool reference matrix, and local loopback security architecture.
- Claude Code Browser Automation: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/claude-code-browser-automation/ — 5-minute setup, prompt recipes, and diagnostic runbooks for Claude Code.
- Multi-Profile Chrome Automation: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/multi-profile-chrome-automation/ — Profile isolation, deterministic hashed ports, and two-dimensional fleet concurrency.
- Parallel Browser Automation: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/parallel-browser-automation/ — Per-tab CDP concurrency benchmarks proving 3.5s for 5 tabs vs 9.3s serial.
- Cursor & Windsurf Browser Automation: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/cursor-browser-automation/ — Connecting AI IDEs, Composer rules, and prompt workflows.
- Real Chrome vs Headless Automation: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/real-chrome-vs-headless/ — Why AI agents fail in headless browsers, and why a signed-in browser avoids login walls (it does not make automation undetectable).
- Rich-Text Editor Automation: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/recipes/rich-text-editors.html — Automating React synthetic setters, DraftJS caret drift, ProseMirror, and CodeMirror.
- In-Page API Harvesting: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/recipes/in-page-api-harvesting.html — In-tab same-origin fetch() with your session cookies, and Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ extraction.
- Multi-LLM Chat: https://jeet-dhandha.github.io/agent-webbridge/recipes/multi-llm-chat.html — Sign in once to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, Duck.ai; one reusable self-adapting local script asks them all the same question in parallel and saves answers to JSONL.

## Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# 1. Install CLI and setup profile
npm i -g agent-webbridge
awb setup "Work"

# 2. Connect to Claude Code as an MCP server
claude mcp add chrome -- npx -y agent-webbridge mcp

# 3. Or install as an Agent Skill
npx skills add jeet-dhandha/agent-webbridge
```

## Community Recipes (awb-recipes)

Browse verified recipes at https://github.com/jeet-dhandha/awb-recipes:
- `github-gist-create`: Create public/secret GitHub Gists via browser UI with active session.
- `google-search-results`: Organic SERP extraction from a real signed-in browser.
- `hn-reply-box`: Interact with Hacker News threads using authentic user cookies.
- `linkedin-feed-posts`: Extract authentic feed updates without session hijacking.
- `npm-most-depended`: Extract package download metrics and dependency hierarchies.
